title: iPhone16Pro same-phone chart photo, 1,000 candidate trials per style
scope: Round-three color recipe refinement ONLY for chart-associated Cool Rose and Amber; all other 26 photographic styles and 10 traditional filters untouched; existing control positions/UI untouched
source_order: Latest user iPhone 16 Pro camera screenshots and photos. Same-style repeated UI entries use latest known one. The 61.73s video shows UI/control values and a web browser in the viewfinder, NOT a 4096-card chart, therefore it was not used as a per-patch color target.
loss: CIELAB D65 DeltaE76 proxy using Python port of FilterEngine baked recipe + approximate Core Image palette transform; 384 training and 256 held-out patch RGB triplets, with bounded parameters and regularization. NOT a YCam phone capture; NOT DeltaE2000; NOT a verified Apple camera similarity score.

model_limits: Monitor white point, automatic exposure and automatic white balance vary between sessions
Only CPU proxy for CIToneCurve/CIVibrance/CIColorControls, no exact Core Image/GPU validation
JPEG captures and partial fiducial recovery limit pixel accuracy
No scene-matched native-vs-YCam iPhone photo pairs and no real iOS device ΔE2000 evaluation
The strongest full-model solution was blended conservatively before deployment
excluded_candidates: IMG_6708/IMG_6729 have incomplete fiducial geometry; IMG_6709/IMG_6723/IMG_6732 low-chroma captures lack trusted exact style/point association and were not treated as labels for other recipes. All other Apple/YCam style formulas are protected pending unequivocal reference image mapping.
cross_validation: An untouched quarter of eligible RGB patches was used to evaluate the fitted candidate. Improves proxy objective, but no guarantee on real-world photographs.
